summary: VDD execution-plan skill creates/repairs complete execution-plan directories only on explicit request; standalone requirements Markdown routes to direct implementation. Select standard/resumable/self-hosted profile before model routing and record rationale; use Sol/high unless typed, capability-probed complex recovery permits Sol/max. Mandatory authority, clarification, lifecycle, knowledge-consumption, and skill-input gates precede plan-ready. Lifecycle: draft -> plan-ready -> implementation-authorized -> implementation-complete -> acceptance-passed -> archived; ownership is separated and Bootstrap is supplemental. Each slice needs behavior, failure intent, acceptance target, dependents, and recovery; VDD does not create new RED evidence. Repairs remain in-place under repair rounds, preserve history, bind findings/hashes/receipts, inventory sibling callsites, and obey lineage/budget triggers. Resumable/self-hosted require append-only 95 report/index. Completion requires required artifacts, observable acceptance, declared negative/legacy path, stable repairs, and current terminal full validation.
